title: rosa × collina var. obtusifolia
intro: Rosa × collina var. obtusifolia, commonly known as the wild rose, is a perennial flowering plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × collina var. obtusifolia include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and anti-spasmodic agent, which can help to relieve pain and reduce anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and fragrances, such as geraniol and linalool, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
